topic: Using the library and its free apps vs buying every book (Barrett vs Freya)

scenes.narration: Same forty books a year, eight hundred dollars apart. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled BUY EVERY BOOK and LIBRARY CARD, comic burst banner reads EIGHT HUNDRED APART, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett and Freya both read about three books every single month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man barrett and woman freya reading on exercise bikes, a chalkboard stamped THREE BOOKS A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each one also streams audiobooks during workouts and long commutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, barrett and freya jogging on treadmills with headphones, floating icons labeled AUDIOBOOK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett buys every hardcover the day it hits the shelf.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, barrett at a bookstore counter buying a stack of hardcovers, a price tag reads EIGHTEEN DOLLARS EACH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eighteen dollars each, three monthly, plus an audiobook subscription too.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, barrett straining under a barbell of books, plates stamped EIGHTEEN DOLLARS and AUDIOBOOK SUBSCRIPTION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Freya gets a free library card and downloads the borrowing app.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, freya holding a card stamped FREE LIBRARY CARD beside a phone showing a borrowing app, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ebooks, audiobooks, and new releases arrive on her tablet free.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, freya on a gym bench with a tablet, floating covers labeled EBOOK AUDIOBOOK NEW RELEASE, a tag reads FREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She only buys the rare book she will reread forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, freya placing one single book on a nearly empty shelf labeled KEEPERS ONLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Barrett spent eight hundred forty dollars on books.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, barrett buried under overflowing book stacks, a gym scoreboard reads EIGHT HUNDRED FORTY SPENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Freya spent thirty six dollars on two true keepers all year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, freya holding two books beside a gym scoreboard reading THIRTY SIX DOLLARS SPENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her eight hundred savings fully funded a vacation fund instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, freya dropping bills into a gym locker labeled VACATION FUND EIGHT HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Get a library card this week. Borrow first, buy rarely. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
